title: feat(plugin-hono-server,plugin-sharing): /auth/me/permissions answers hasAnyQueue from the ownership-queue service
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XRMukpcDXWQXQ4GaVYCkErv)_

Part of #28508 (the server half; the strict spec response schema for the carrier is the other half, see Acceptance notes)

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`GET /auth/me/permissions` 的每个已登录响应多一个布尔 `hasAnyQueue`，表示当前用户所在组织是否至少有一个归属队列（声明的、未被启用台账关掉的队列，或本组织的 `sys_queue` 行）。答案由 plugin-sharing 的归属队列服务新方法 `hasAnyQueue(organizationId)` 在系统上下文里算出。
- **为什么改**：列表工具栏的「在队列中」开关要知道这个组织有没有队列（#28428，路线 A 已裁）。普通成员读 `sys_queue` 是 403，自己判断不了；现在服务端只回答这一个布尔，不给名字、不给数量。
- **风险与回滚**：只加字段，不加路由，不放宽成员对 `sys_queue` / `sys_queue_member` 的读权限（测试钉住 403）。服务未注册、无此方法或抛错都答 `false`，且不影响响应其余部分。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts`（`organizationHasAnyQueue` 与三个响应分支）、`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/ownership-queue-service.ts`（`hasAnyQueue`）、`packages/verify/src/me-permissions-has-any-queue.test.ts`（真实 HTTP 门五个用例）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run src/me-permissions-has-any-queue.test.ts`，预期 5 passed：只有 `sys_queue` 行 → true，只有声明队列 → true，声明队列被关 → false，都没有 → false，服务未注册 → false，且每例成员读 `/data/sys_queue` 仍是 403。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（contract review 由席位按 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 完成后入队）。

## What changes

- **`OwnershipQueueService.hasAnyQueue(organizationId)`** (`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`). `true` exactly when some queue name would resolve in that organization: a declared queue the activation ledger leaves on, or a `sys_queue` row of the organization that does not sit under a declared queue's name. It reuses `activeDeclaredQueues()` and `authoredQueueNames()`, the reads `queuesOf` already makes, so the registry-first rule and the ledger filter stay in one place; there is no second resolver. It is a method on the class only: the spec contract `IOwnershipQueueService` is not edited in this PR (see Acceptance notes).
- **`GET /auth/me/permissions` carries `hasAnyQueue: boolean`** (`@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`) on every authenticated body:
  - the full body (`mePermissionsBody`, now seven required grant keys, so tsc refuses a caller that drops it);
  - the degraded body (no SecurityPlugin): the question does not depend on it;
  - the closed body of the outer catch: `false`, since a fault vouches for nothing it did not finish.
  - An anonymous caller still gets `{ "authenticated": false }` only, and the service is not asked.
- **Reaching the service** (`organizationHasAnyQueue`): the kernel locator under `OWNERSHIP_QUEUE_SERVICE`, for the caller's `tenantId` (the organization `queuesOf` is asked for on the sitting-record path). No service, a service without the method, or a throw answers `false`; a throw logs one `warn` line and the rest of the body still answers in full. The function never throws.
- **Carrier choice.** `/auth/me/permissions`, the card's candidate: the console's `MePermissionsProvider` already fetches it once per session (`DEFAULT_ENDPOINT = '/api/v1/auth/me/permissions'`), so the toolbar needs no extra request on list mount. No route is added.
- **Fixtures moved.** Three exact-body pins in plugin-hono-server gain the new key as `false` (no ownership-queue service in those mounts): `current-user-endpoints-outer-catch-closed.test.ts` (closed body and the degraded byte-for-byte body) and `current-user-endpoints-execution-context-envelope.test.ts`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28508-me-permissions-has-any-queue.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` and `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` (Metadata-protocol `none` takes `patch`, AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). `@objectstack/verify` gains a test file only, which its `files[]` (`dist`) does not ship.

The field name for #28428's consumer and for the spec half: **`hasAnyQueue`**, type `boolean`, on the authenticated `/auth/me/permissions` body.

## Tests

- **Service** (`plugin-sharing/src/ownership-queue.test.ts`, new describe, 6 cases + 1 line in the no-engine case): row only ⇒ true for its own organization and false for another; declared and on ⇒ true; declared and switched off with no row ⇒ false (and `resolveQueue` agrees); a row under a switched-off declared name ⇒ false (it resolves nowhere); neither ⇒ false; a failed `sys_queue` read ⇒ false, the same posture as `resolveQueue`.
- **Route** (`plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints-has-any-queue.test.ts`, 9 cases): the service's `true` / `false` carried as is, asked once with the caller's organization; no service ⇒ false with no warn; a service without the method ⇒ false; a throwing service ⇒ false, one warn, body otherwise full; degraded branch carries it; closed body carries `false`; anonymous body unchanged and service not asked; the only queue-named key on the wire is the boolean.
- **HTTP door** (`verify/src/me-permissions-has-any-queue.test.ts`, 5 cases, two `bootStack` boots, a fresh sign-up as the plain member): the five Acceptance item 2 cases, each also asserting the member's `GET /data/sys_queue` is 403 with `code: PERMISSION_DENIED`. The switched-off case goes through the real activation door (`POST /security/_activation/queue/:name` as the admin); the absent-service case removes `ownership-queue` from the kernel's service maps.

<details><summary>Red first, green after, ablations (all through rebuilt dist/)</summary>

- **Red on main.** Service + route tests, before the implementation: `ownership-queue.test.ts` 7 failed / 34 passed; `current-user-endpoints-has-any-queue.test.ts` 8 failed / 1 passed (the anonymous case, unchanged by design). HTTP door with `origin/main`'s two source files checked out and both packages rebuilt (`ablation-dist-preflight --absent hasAnyQueue` on plugin-hono-server: absent from all 6 built files): **5 failed (5)**. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob = HEAD, rebuilt, marker present again in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`.
- **Green.** `ownership-queue.test.ts` 41/41, `current-user-endpoints-has-any-queue.test.ts` 9/9, door test 5/5.
- **Ablation 1, service always false** (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1, marker `ablation28508-always-false` present in plugin-sharing `dist/index.js` + `dist/index.mjs`): service cases "row only" and "declared on" red; door cases **1** and **2** red, 3 passed. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt, marker absent.
- **Ablation 2, ledger filter dropped** (`activeDeclaredQueues()` → `declaredItems()`, marker `ablation28508-no-ledger` in dist): service cases "switched off" and "row under a switched-off name" red; door case **3** red, 4 passed. Restored the same way.
- **Ablation 3, the 403 pin** (member_default given `sys_queue` read, marker `ablation28508-member-reads-queue` in plugin-security dist): door **5 failed (5)**, each `expected 200 to be 403`. Restored the same way; plugin-security rebuilt, marker absent.
- A first attempt at ablation 1 put the marker in a comment, which the build strips, so the dist preflight could not see it (the test still went red). It was rerun with the marker in code, which is the reading above.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise gap on Target 4 / Acceptance 1 (the spec half).** Measured on `origin/main` `004871f7`: `/auth/me/permissions` has no spec response schema. Nothing in `packages/spec` declares its body; the console types it with a hand-written `MePermissionsResponse` interface (`ui/packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx`) and fetches it raw; `packages/client` has no method for it. The nearest schema, `GetEffectivePermissionsResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`), declares only `objects` and `systemPermissions`, is a non-strict `z.object`, and backs the optional `getEffectivePermissions` protocol method that nothing implements. So "declared strictly, unknown sibling still refused" means a new strict schema for the whole body (three shapes: anonymous, degraded, full/closed). That half is with the maintainer through the seat; this PR leaves `packages/spec` untouched and says `Part of`.
- **Contract method.** `hasAnyQueue` joins `IOwnershipQueueService` with the spec half. Until then the route reads it through a local optional type (`AnyQueueReader`), the same optional shape the contract already uses for `declaredQueueNamed`.
- **Organization id.** The route passes the session's `tenantId`. With `null` (no active organization), the service counts every `sys_queue` row, which is what `queuesOf` already does for `null`.
- The ui consumer (#28428) is unchanged here; it returns to dispatch with the field name above.

## Verification

All readings on head `3563cd56` (the final commit), after a whole-workspace build (`turbo run build --concurrency=2`, 118 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0).

- **Package suites.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server test`: Test Files 37 passed (37), Tests 466 passed (466). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: Test Files 58 passed (58), Tests 1302 passed (1302). Door test: Tests 5 passed (5). VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck` (each runs `check:test-typecheck` too): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Lint.** `eslint --no-inline-config` over `plugin-sharing/src`, `plugin-hono-server/src` and the new verify test: exit 0. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Consumers of the carrier body.** The packages that read `/auth/me/permissions` through a real handler: `@objectstack/runtime` `request-execution-context.conformance.test.ts` + `in-process-session-renewal.pin.test.ts` (24/24), `@objectstack/http-conformance` `hono-dispatcher-result-response.conformance.test.ts` (3/3), `@objectstack/verify` `parent-write-reach.test.ts` + the door test (15/15). The other test files that name the route either mock their own body or assert one key (`toMatchObject`); the only exact-body pins were the three in plugin-hono-server, updated above. The console's `MePermissionsProvider` reads the body through a hand-written interface and ignores unknown keys.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 64 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe; all 64 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Three needed their prerequisite first (teardown self-test: one fetch of its pinned commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`: the workspace build) and one was a real red fixed in `3563cd56` (`check:objectql-double-limit`: the new route test's `find` double now applies the caller's `limit`).
- **Not local.** `test:repo` and the full Test Core shards are CI's (this diff changes no `repo`-project test). No full dogfood battery is owed: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
